aiMetadata.description: Retrieves the budget for a single month from an Actual Budget server, including each category group and category for that month. Use it to read budgeted, spent, and balance figures for a specific period; the month and year must be supplied as separate inputs. Read-only and idempotent.

account_id.description: ID of the account you want to import a transaction to

amount.description: The dollar value of the transaction

imported_id.description: Unique ID given by the bank for importing

transfer_id.description: ID of the transaction in the other account for the transfer

cleared.description: Flag indicating if the transaction has cleared or not

imported_payee.description: Raw description when importing, representing the original value

aiMetadata.description: Adds a single transaction to a specified account in Actual Budget. Use it to record one transaction with fields such as date, amount, payee, category, and notes; the target account ID is required. Not idempotent — each call appends another transaction unless an Imported ID is supplied, which Actual uses to deduplicate against prior imports.

account_id.description: ID of the account you want to import a transaction to

transactions.description: A json array of the transaction object

aiMetadata.description: Bulk-imports an array of transaction objects into a specified account in Actual Budget. Use it to add many transactions at once rather than one at a time; requires the target account ID and a JSON array of transactions (errors if not an array). Not idempotent — each call appends the transactions unless individual entries carry an Imported ID, which Actual uses to deduplicate against prior imports.

Lists all budget categories from an Actual Budget server. Use it to discover available categories and their IDs, typically to resolve a category ID before importing a transaction. Takes no input; read-only and idempotent.

Lists all accounts from an Actual Budget server. Use it to discover available accounts and their IDs, typically to resolve the account ID required by the import-transaction actions. Takes no input; read-only and idempotent.
